checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals store-creative-and-experiments, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 'store-creative-and-experiments' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: Generated store images stay text-free; Arabic and English overlays are added in the build, never baked in.
checks.rule: Body states generated screenshots and preview frames are text-free and any overlay is added in the build by the designer, never baked into a generated image.

checks.description: Each store A/B experiment changes exactly one variable and reads a metric tied to the success_metric.
checks.rule: Body states each experiment has one hypothesis, changes exactly one variable, reads a metric tied to the success_metric, and has a decision rule.

checks.description: Experiments encode a read window and treatment limits: minimum 7 days on Google Play, up to 90 days and at most 3 treatments on Apple PPO.
checks.rule: Body and template state Google Play store listing experiments run a minimum of 7 days for a full weekly cycle and Apple PPO runs up to 90 days with at most 3 treatments, one asset per test, read after the window closes.

checks.description: Custom Product Pages are planned, mapped to segments, with assigned keywords and 170-character promo text, via the PPO-then-CPP workflow.
checks.rule: Body and template describe Apple Custom Product Pages (up to 70), each mapped to a segment with its own screenshots, assigned keywords, and promotional text up to 170 characters, and state the PPO-then-CPP workflow of deploying a PPO winner as a CPP for the segment that responded best.

checks.description: The reviews policy escalates bug, refund, privacy, safety, or legal matters rather than sending a templated reply, and never exposes reviewer personal data.
checks.rule: Body sets escalation rules for bug, refund, data or privacy, and safety or legal reviews and forbids exposing a reviewer's personal data in a public reply.

checks.description: Creative direction applies the brand visual constants and stays premium and uncluttered.
checks.rule: Body names the visual constants #141414, #1A1A1A, and emerald #009975 and requires a premium, uncluttered result.

checks.description: Publishing creative or launching an experiment is a gated action behind the human gate.
checks.rule: Body states publishing creative or launching an experiment is a gated action behind the human gate and silence is not approval.

checks.description: No invented Skill Path title, content lineup, instructor name, offer, or price, and no accreditation implication.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing Skill Path titles, content lineup, instructor names, offers, and prices, instructs stop-and-ask when absent, and forbids implying a certificate is accredited.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no U+2014 em dash, no U+0640 tatweel, and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
